name: usage
description: Burn Meter (5-hour and weekly limits with pace), Cache Clock (prompt-cache countdown and cold-return cost) and Compaction Alert, in one band row. Spends no tokens.

mod_burn_enabled.title: Burn Meter
mod_burn_enabled.description: Show the 5-hour and weekly limits with pace and forecast

mod_cache_enabled.title: Cache Clock
mod_cache_enabled.description: Show the prompt-cache countdown, the cold-return cost and the pane

mod_compaction_enabled.title: Compaction Alert
mod_compaction_enabled.description: Show how close the context is to auto-compact

minBandRows.title: Minimum band rows
minBandRows.description: Below this many free rows the usage row stays silent

mascots.title: Mascot images
mascots.description: auto and on draw the Carrot and Pom stills; off draws the block mark instead

pricesJson.title: Price overrides (JSON)
pricesJson.description: Optional JSON replacing price rows by family, e.g. {"asOf":"2026-10-12","sonnet":{"input":2,"cacheRead":0.1,"write5m":2.5,"write1h":4}}. Empty uses the built-in table

burn_hotAt.title: Hot at (projected %)
burn_hotAt.description: A window is HOT when its projected use at reset reaches this percent

burn_plentyBelow.title: Plenty below (projected %)
burn_plentyBelow.description: A window is PLENTY when its projected use at reset is below this percent

burn_recentWindowMin.title: Recent-rate window (min)
burn_recentWindowMin.description: Minutes of samples behind the 5-hour recent rate

burn_minElapsedFiveMin.title: 5H learning time (min)
burn_minElapsedFiveMin.description: Minutes of the 5-hour window before a pace is shown

burn_minElapsedSevenHr.title: 7D learning time (h)
burn_minElapsedSevenHr.description: Hours of the weekly window before a pace is shown

burn_showSpend.title: Show spend limit
burn_showSpend.description: Show a third meter for a gateway spend limit

burn_bites.title: Carrot bites
burn_bites.description: Nibble the Carrot as the weekly limit fills

burn_staleMin.title: Stale after (min)
burn_staleMin.description: Dim the meter when no reading arrived for this long

cache_ttl.title: Cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: auto follows events, learning, cache-tax and a subscription guess; or fix 5m or 1h

cache_followCacheTax.title: Follow cache-tax
cache_followCacheTax.description: Use cache-tax's TTL when it is installed and no better source exists

cache_keepwarmLine.title: Keepwarm line
cache_keepwarmLine.description: Show the cache-tax keepwarm status in the pane

cache_expiringSec.title: Expiring at (s)
cache_expiringSec.description: Warn colour when the cache has this many seconds left

cache_assumeSubscriptionTtl.title: Assumed TTL, subscription
cache_assumeSubscriptionTtl.description: TTL assumed on a plan with rate limits when nothing else is known

cache_assumeApiTtl.title: Assumed TTL, API
cache_assumeApiTtl.description: TTL assumed without rate limits when nothing else is known

cache_showSavings.title: Show savings
cache_showSavings.description: Show what the cache saved today

cache_pane_autoOpen.title: Open pane at first request
cache_pane_autoOpen.description: Open the cache-clock pane once per session at the first request

compaction_showFrom.title: Show from (%)
compaction_showFrom.description: Show the context chip from this fill

compaction_showCount.title: Show compaction count
compaction_showCount.description: Append the number of compactions this session
